dialogHint: Encrypted notebooks are not supported and are skipped automatically.
noSelection: Select at least one exportable notebook
exportDone: Export complete. Saving the ZIP now
optionIncludeSubDocsDesc: Include every subdocument under the selected notebooks.
optionAddTitleDesc: Write the document title at the top of each exported Markdown file.
optionMarkdownYFMDesc: Write YAML metadata at the top of each Markdown file.
optionRemoveAssetsIDDesc: Remove SiYuan block IDs from exported asset file names.
importHint: Choose a Markdown ZIP (for example, one exported by this plugin) and import it into a notebook.
importPathHint: Leave empty or use / for the notebook root; enter a document path to import under that document.
importNoFile: Choose a ZIP file to import
importSkipRootDesc: If the ZIP contains a single top-level folder, enable this to avoid creating an extra document level.
quickIntro: Set the default export notebook and import folder first; then use the hotkeys for one-click runs.
quickExportHint: Press ⇧⌘E to export this notebook; export options come from the plugin settings.
quickSaveModeHint: “Download directly” saves to the browser's default download folder without a save dialog.
quickImportFolderHint: Enter a local Markdown folder path outside the workspace.
quickImportPathHint: Leave empty or / for the notebook root.
quickImportSkipRootDesc: If the folder has a single top-level directory, enable this to avoid an extra document level.
quickHotkeyHint: Change the hotkeys in Settings → Keymap.
quickNotConfiguredExport: No default export notebook configured. Set it in the Quick tab first.
quickNotConfiguredImport: No import folder or target notebook configured. Set them in the Quick tab first.
